name: curtain
description: The full wrap-up of a lane in one command, /curtain (merge-pr, session-close, close the lane, exit), with a closing show above the prompt: Clawd sweeps the stage while the curtain comes down

size.title: Curtain size
size.description: How much room the show takes above the prompt: small (a 6-row stage), medium (9 rows), full (12 rows), or off (no show; /curtain still works and still exits on its done signal).
